nodes.name: GND
nodes.semantic_role: System common ground for all digital and analog circuits

nodes.name: VIN_5V
nodes.semantic_role: External 5V input from USB port, primary input to the 3.3V LDO

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: XC6206 3.3V LDO regulator. Steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3. No enable pin present, always on when input power applied. This module is the sole provider of the 3.3V rail and must include input/output bypass capacitors. Accepts external 5V input and distributes generated 3.3V to all downstream modules.

nodes.name: usb_uart_bridge
nodes.description: CH340 USB to UART bridge. Interfaces to host PC via USB D+/- lines (UD_P, UD_N). Provides UART TXD/RXD lines to MCU. Crystal oscillator needed on XI/XO pins (typically 12 MHz). VCC pin requires 5V from USB input. V3 pin requires 3.3V from LDO for I/O level shifting. DTR/RTS/CTS/DSR/DCD/RI pins are legacy RS-232 control signals; for basic operation, these can be left unconnected or tied appropriately via resistors. For firmware programming via UART, DTR and RTS may need passive networks to control MCU BOOT and RESET pins; this external network is part of programming interface, not core bridge.

nodes.name: GND
nodes.description: Ground. Connect to USB bus ground.

nodes.name: TXD
nodes.description: Serial data output to MCU RXD.

nodes.name: RXD
nodes.description: Serial data input from MCU TXD.

nodes.name: V3
nodes.description: Internal 3.3V regulator output. At 5V: connect 0.1uF cap to GND. At 3.3V: connect to VCC.

nodes.name: UD_P
nodes.description: USB D+ data line. Connect directly to USB connector.

nodes.name: UD_N
nodes.description: USB D- data line. Connect directly to USB connector.

nodes.name: CTS
nodes.description: MODEM Clear To Send, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DSR
nodes.description: MODEM Data Set Ready, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: RI
nodes.description: MODEM Ring Indicator, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DCD
nodes.description: MODEM Data Carrier Detect, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DTR
nodes.description: MODEM Data Terminal Ready, active low. Often used for MCU auto-reset.

nodes.name: RTS
nodes.description: MODEM Request To Send, active low. Often used for MCU boot mode.

nodes.name: R232
nodes.description: RS232 enable, active high. Built-in pull-down. Leave floating for TTL mode.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: CH32V003 RISC-V MCU. Main controller. Operates at 3.3V core voltage (VDD). I2C peripheral needed for EEPROM communication; must configure GPIO pins for I2C (e.g., PC0/PC1). BOOT mode determined by state of PD0 at reset (needs pull-up/down resistor). For UART programming, PD0 and PD1 serve as RXD and TXD, connectable to CH340. MCU will also manage any user I/O via remaining GPIOs. NRST pin (not listed) may be present on variant; if not, reset via power cycle. All unused GPIOs can be configured as input with internal pull-up or left floating with external pull-up to prevent leakage.

nodes.name: PD7
nodes.description: GPIO, alt: NRST (active low reset). Must have pull-up or reset circuit.

nodes.name: PD1
nodes.description: GPIO, alt: SWIO (single-wire debug)/T1CH3N. Default debug pin.

nodes.name: eeprom_config
nodes.description: AT24C256 256Kbit I2C EEPROM for configuration storage. I2C slave device. A0, A1, A2 pins (not listed in component data; assumed available on package) must be tied to GND or VCC to set I2C address; default address 0x50. Requires pull-up resistors on SDA and SCL lines; ownership of pull-ups is with MCU module. WP pin (if present) should be tied to GND for write enable.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: Address bit 0. Tie to GND or VCC. I2C address = 1010_A2_A1_A0.

nodes.name: A1
nodes.description: Address bit 1. Tie to GND or VCC.

nodes.name: A2
nodes.description: Address bit 2. Tie to GND or VCC. Up to 8 devices on one bus.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect. GND=write enabled, VCC=write inhibited.
